shots.name: halftone-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Halftone card: Style menu, Preset menu showing Newsprint, then Dot Size and Angle under Pattern, Ink, Paper and Amount under Color, beside the preview of the dancer printed in fine dots of near-black ink on cream paper
shots.caption: Halftone with the Newsprint preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Dot Size. 3 — Angle: 45° turns the screen like a newspaper's. 4 — Ink: the colour of the dots. 5 — Paper: the colour between them. 6 — Amount.

shots.name: dither-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Dithering card: Preset menu showing Game Screen, Pixel Size under Pattern, Levels and Amount under Color, beside a strip of the preview turned into chunky pixels of a few colours
shots.caption: Dithering with the Game Screen preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Pixel Size. 3 — Levels: steps per colour channel. 4 — Amount.

shots.name: riso-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Riso card: Preset menu showing Postcard, Dot Size and Registration under Pattern, Dark Ink, Warm Ink and Amount under Color, beside the preview of the dancer printed in teal and red dots, her dress light, the stage a dark teal
shots.caption: Riso with the Postcard preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Dot Size. 3 — Registration: how far the inks slip apart. 4 — Dark Ink. 5 — Warm Ink. 6 — Amount.

shots.name: riso-glow-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Riso Glow card: Preset menu showing Neon Sign, Dot Size and Registration under Pattern, Glow and Speed under Glow & Pulse, Shadow Ink, Glow Ink and Amount under Color, beside the preview of the dancer printed in teal and coral dots on a dark teal stage, her dress glowing coral
shots.caption: Riso Glow with the Neon Sign preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Dot Size. 3 — Glow: how brightly the glow ink shines. 4 — Speed: how fast the glow breathes. 5 — Glow Ink: the colour that glows.

shots.name: paper-print-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Paper Print card: Preset menu showing Photogravure, Grain Size and Texture under Pattern, Ink, Paper and Amount under Color, beside the preview of the dancer printed in a fine cream grain out of an even dark brown
shots.caption: Paper Print with the Photogravure preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Grain Size. 3 — Texture: the paper's bumps. 4 — Ink. 5 — Paper.
